programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Right Thing
programmes.d: Jonathan inspires a young man to help the grandfather who has recently been placed in a nursing home.
Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance.
Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.
Jonathan and Mark discover that the star player's injury has resulted in drug dependency.
Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.
Jonathan places a homeless, mentally impaired teen with a wealthy, but troubled, family.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 1
programmes.d: Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.
Jonathan and Mark help a bullied orphan whose grandfather may lose him to a heartless social worker.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark are helping patients at Camp Good Times in different ways. But a father still refuses to deal with his son's illness.
Mark switches places with an attractive movie star who has a low opinion of men.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Bless the Boys in Blue
programmes.d: Jonathan relinquishes his angelic powers for awhile and realizes the dangers that Mark has faced being a police officer.
Jonathan helps reunite his lonely widow (Dorothy McGuire) and their estranged daughter.
An aspiring actress wants to be accepted for who she really is, not in the image her well-meaning dad tries to transform her into.
An errant angel has been on probation for two centuries because he's always breaking the rules.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Devil and Jonathan Smith
programmes.d: Mark has been tricked into selling his soul in order to save a little girl's life. But the Devil has another agenda: acquiring Jonathan's soul.
A father attempts to have a memorial made to commemorate his son who was killed in Vietnam.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Birds of a Feather
programmes.d: Factory workers ignore ground-water contamination, even though it is making their children sick. As a result, Jonathan takes drastic measures to force them to face the facts.
Mark asks Jonathan to help erase everything bad that's happened to him recently.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Popcorn, Peanuts and Crackerjacks
programmes.d: A minor-league baseball team never wins, so Jonathan and Mark set out to help them. They also come to the aid of an elderly vendor who has been kicked out of the stadium.
A dying woman was forced to leave a son behind in the Soviet Union during World War II.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Smile in the Third Row
programmes.d: The lead actor in a Broadway play claims that God is attending the show's performances, sitting in a third-row orchestra seat.
Tragedy occurs when a Neo-Nazi disputes the Holocaust with the son of a death camp survivor.
The teenage daughter of Mark's friend tries to find her biological mother. It may tear the family apart.
A despondent novelist (Lew Ayres) finds inspiration in reliving a teenage romance.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Monster - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark connect a young blind woman with a disfigured artist.
A reporter uncovers a secret about the past of a woman who runs a home for unwed mothers.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Monster - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance. He defends the young artist with a facial deformity who has been accused of assaulting a blind girl.
Jonathan and Mark persuade a youngster with Down's Syndrome to join the Special Olympics.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Good Doctor
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark go to work at a football team. They learn that one of the players has been getting drugs from the team doctor.
Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty wants to adopt the boy with Down's Syndrome.
A homeless boy wishes that someone would love him.
A man whose son died in Vietnam learns that he has an Amerasian grandson.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Close Encounters of the Heavenly Kind
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark help a bullied orphan whose eccentric grandfather is in danger of losing him to a heartless social worker.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Change of Life
programmes.d: Mark switches places with an attractive movie star who has a low opinion of men.
A man whose son died in Vietnam learns that he has an Amerasian grandson.
Jonathan must help his own widow regain her love for life.
A children's-show host has a warm-hearted TV persona but is actually a cynic at heart.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Last Assignment
programmes.d: An errant angel has been on probation for two centuries because he's always breaking the rules.
Another angel is upset that Jonathan has been assigned to find a mate for his widow.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Bind the Wounds
programmes.d: A father attempts to have a memorial made to commemorate his son who was killed in Vietnam.
Bickering couples go on a trip to learn what it was that brought them together.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Heaven on Earth
programmes.d: Mark asks Jonathan to help erase everything bad that's happened to him recently. Mark's idea is to create his own vision of heaven on Earth.
Jonathan and Mark maneuver to keep a bride and groom on the way to the altar.
A dying woman was forced to leave a son behind in the Soviet Union during World War II.
A boy genius at college is outcasted by his less intelligent but more socially adept schoolmates.
Tragedy occurs when a Neo-Nazi disputes the Holocaust with the son of a death camp survivor.
A wealthy businessman would like to bridge the gap between himself and his son.
Jonathan and Mark assist a novelist who's given up. Also, they motivate the man's grandson, who has yet to tap into his literary potential.
A U.S. senator opposes Jonathan and Mark's efforts to pass legislation to save a little girl's life.
A reporter uncovers a secret about the past of a woman who runs a home for unwed mothers.
Mark plans to give a recent windfall to a boys' club. But first he must deal with some con artists.
